_about: Card corners of every complete instant print in each fixture, in image pixels, ordered top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left of the card itself (the thick border is the bottom). Rough corners were placed by hand on a grid and snapped to the strongest nearby edge with label_tool.py; sides marked pinned run into the image edge. A photo with an empty list has no complete print that should be framed automatically.
